hooks.prompt:
You are evaluating whether a Claude Code session has completed meaningful implementation work that deserves a work report before the session ends.

Analyze the conversation and determine the appropriate action:

## IMMEDIATELY APPROVE (no report needed) if ANY of these are true:
- The conversation contains '[REPORT_SAVED]' or '[obsidian-report-sync]' — report already saved
- The session was purely exploratory (reading files, searching code, answering questions)
- The conversation is very short (fewer than ~5 back-and-forth exchanges)
- No code was written, modified, committed, or deleted
- The user only asked questions or requested explanations
- The session only involved planning (Plan Mode) without implementation

## BLOCK (report needed) if ALL of these are true:
- Code was actually written, modified, refactored, or deleted
- The work appears to be completed (not abandoned mid-way)
- No '[REPORT_SAVED]' or '[obsidian-report-sync]' marker exists in the conversation

Examples of reportable work: feature implementation, bug fixes, refactoring, test writing, configuration changes, build fixes, dependency updates.

If you decide to BLOCK, use this systemMessage to instruct Claude to generate and save the report:

---
Before ending this session, you must create a work report and save it to Obsidian.

1. Generate a report in this exact markdown format:

```
# <Concise title describing the work done>

## Task Summary
[2-4 sentences summarizing what was accomplished]

## Changed Files
[List files changed with brief description of each change. Use `git diff --name-status` if available]

## Key Decisions
[Bullet points of technical decisions made during the session]

## Test Results
[Test execution results, or 'N/A' if no tests were run]

## Remaining Issues
[Follow-up work, TODOs, known issues. 'None' if everything is complete]
```

2. Save it by running this exact command (replace the content between EOF markers with your generated report):

```bash
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/save-report-to-obsidian.sh <<'REPORT_EOF'
<your generated report markdown here>
REPORT_EOF
```

3. After the script runs, output a message containing '[REPORT_SAVED]' to confirm.

4. Then you may end the session.
---
